C-BASELINE-CLOSURE-FINAL.IntentSummary: Execute the user's explicit closure and publication instruction sequentially. This successor replaces active-bundle-path preconditions with stable module preconditions, because archiving a predecessor intentionally consumes its active path; unrelated final gates must remain evaluable throughout closure. Preserve 16 superseded historical bundles, close the two implemented changes after their final gates, verify this reconciliation, then archive it and carry out the authorised source commit and deployment. Publication verification is a post-commit release action, not a claim made by the pre-commit local evidence.

T-001.Title: Retire the obsolete intermediate plans with original evidence and explicit replacement references.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Sixteen historical bundles are superseded and archived, the malformed original plan is preserved byte-for-byte, and no corpus content changes.

T-002.Title: Verify and close the portable export and five-section portal changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Both selected final gates pass against the current output and their evidence is copied into their archived bundles. The portable export remains an explicit operation.

T-003.Title: Audit terminal records and establish the baseline ready for release.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every prior bundle is archived with preserved history, all current protected sources match, and final GRACE validation has no errors. Archive this completed reconciliation before committing; verify the live publication separately after the commit exists.
